title: Diffusion Language Models for Mobile Edge Agentic AI: Foundations, Applications, and Challenges
abstract: arXiv:2609.04778v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a non-autoregressive alternative for mobile edge agentic artificial intelligence (AI) by refining tokens through iterative denoising rather than left-to-right decoding. Compared with autoregressive Transformer-based large language models (LLMs), DLMs can update multiple uncertain tokens in parallel and exploit bidirectional context throughout the generation process, enabling more flexible quality-latency trade-offs beyond fixed sequential decoding. These properties are particularly attractive for edge agents, where partial refinement, early exit, and constraint-guided correction can reduce response delay and communication overhead while improving robustness under noisy, incomplete, or dynamic contexts. This survey reviews DLM foundations and analyzes their suitability for edge settings under latency, memory, energy, bandwidth, privacy, and reliability constraints. translated_title: 面向移动边缘智能体AI的扩散语言模型：基础、应用与挑战
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型通过迭代去噪来精炼token，而非采用从左到右的自回归解码，为移动边缘智能体人工智能提供了一种非自回归的替代方案。与基于自回归Transformer的大型语言模型相比，扩散语言模型能够并行更新多个不确定的token，并在整个生成过程中利用双向上下文，从而实现超越固定顺序解码的更灵活的质量-延迟权衡。这些特性对边缘智能体尤其具有吸引力，因为在噪声、不完整或动态的上下文环境中，部分精炼、提前退出和约束引导校正等方式可以降低响应延迟和通信开销，同时提升鲁棒性。本综述回顾了扩散语言模型的基础理论，并在延迟、内存、能耗、带宽、隐私和可靠性等约束条件下分析了其对边缘环境的适用性，同时涵盖了资源高效架构等内容。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了扩散语言模型的基础原理，阐明其凭借并行token更新与双向上下文建模在移动边缘智能体AI场景中实现灵活质量-延迟权衡的独特优势，并分析了其在延迟、内存、能耗、带宽、隐私与可靠性约束下的应用与挑战。
en_tdlr: This survey presents the foundations of diffusion language models, highlights their unique advantages for mobile edge agentic AI through parallel token updates and bidirectional context modeling for flexible quality-latency trade-offs, and analyzes their applications and challenges under latency, memory, energy, bandwidth, privacy, and reliability constraints.
